case.title: Nyalenda enumerator submits from the middle of Kondele, inside a valid project area but not her own

submissions.open_text: Hand pump handle broke and was fixed by neighbours.
Buys jerricans from a boda boda rider twice weekly.

case.why: A fabricator could fill interviews from home in the neighbouring area, betting the check only asks whether the point is inside any project area. (34.77, -0.08) is inside Kondele but outside E02's assigned Nyalenda (lng 34.74-34.76, lat -0.11..-0.09). The rule uses the contributor's own area, so it must fire; an implementation testing against the union of areas would miss it. The 'own' submission at (34.75, -0.10) is inside Nyalenda. Other checks quiet: 2 submissions about 5 h apart, distinct texts, 23-25 min durations, daytime, one device, no transcripts.
